title: Customer Care Coordinator
description:
Customer Care Coordinator
Company: SME Residential Developer
Location: Watford
Salary: Up to £35k

About the Role
The Customer Care Coordinator will manage post-completion customer enquiries, coordinate defect resolution and maintain clear communication with residents throughout the aftercare process.
Cityscape is recruiting on behalf of a residential development business delivering new homes, with the role supporting customers following handover and coordinating remedial works with contractors and internal teams.

What You Will Do

As Customer Care Coordinator, you will coordinate customer service matters from initial notification through to satisfactory resolution.
- Manage customer enquiries and defects, recording issues accurately and keeping residents informed throughout the resolution process.
- Coordinate subcontractor appointments and remedial works, ensuring reported defects are progressed and completed within agreed timescales.
- Liaise with site teams, contractors and customers to arrange access and communicate planned repair appointments clearly.
- Maintain accurate customer care records, updating defect information, correspondence, appointments and completion status for each property.
- Monitor outstanding remedial works, following up contractors and escalating unresolved customer issues through the appropriate internal channels.
- Support customers professionally following handover, providing clear information on reported defects, appointments and progress towards resolution.

What You Bring
- Experience as a Customer Care Coordinator within residential development, housebuilding, construction aftercare.
- Demonstrate experience coordinating property defects and remedial works from initial customer report through to confirmed completion.
- Provide experience liaising directly with homeowners or residents regarding repairs, appointments, access arrangements and outstanding issues.
- Demonstrate experience coordinating subcontractors, trades and site teams to complete post-handover defect and customer care works.
- Provide experience maintaining accurate defect logs, customer correspondence and records across multiple properties and outstanding work items.
- Demonstrate experience handling customer complaints professionally while coordinating practical actions to resolve property-related issues effectively.

Desirable
- COINS experience
- Demonstrate experience working for a UK housebuilder or residential developer within a dedicated post-completion customer care team.
- Provide experience using customer relationship management or defect management systems to record queries, appointments and completed works.
- Demonstrate experience supporting customers during new-home warranty and post-completion defect periods within residential development.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Advisor

Location: Watford
Salary: 25000 per annum
Hours: Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week
Working hours: Flexible start between 8:00am-9:00am, finishing between 4:00pm-5:00pm with a 30-minute lunchbreak
Contract: Permanent
Start: Immediate

About the Opportunity

We are delighted to be recruiting for a Customer Service Advisor to join a well-established organisation that is currently going through an exciting period of growth.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a growing team at an important time for the business. As a Customer Service Advisor, you will become an integral part of the customer service team, providing a high-quality and professional service to clients throughout the full customer journey - from onboarding and quotations through to reporting, invoicing and managing day-to-day communications.

You will play an important role in ensuring customers receive an excellent level of service, working closely with internal departments and external clients to ensure projects are delivered efficiently and effectively.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established and expanding organisation where you can make a genuine contribution to the customer experience, develop your skills and build a long-term career within a supportive team environment.

If you are organised, customer-focused and thrive in a busy environment, we would love to hear from you.

The Role

As a Customer Service Advisor, you will be responsible for delivering an excellent customer experience while working closely with internal teams and external clients.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Supporting the team with the administration associated with onboarding new clients and the continued delivery of excellent customer service.
- Managing and responding to incoming client communications via email and telephone in a timely and professional manner.
- Acting as a first point of contact for client queries and resolving issues wherever possible.
- Escalating and coordinating queries with the appropriate internal teams where required.
- Inputting and maintaining accurate customer information within LIMS and other internal systems.
- Liaising with customers regarding sample paperwork, COCs and purchase orders.
- Preparing accurate, fit-for-purpose quotations within the approved authority level.
- Coordinating logistical queries and arrangements where required.
- Managing subcontract laboratory services when necessary.
- Liaising with analytical teams to ensure customer projects are delivered successfully.
- Coordinating the delivery of customer receipts, reports and invoices.
- Providing accurate client information and updates to the wider team.
- Working with the SCSA and Customer Service Manager as part of a continual improvement process.
- Building and maintaining strong, professional relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
- Processing media orders and developing knowledge of sampling techniques.
- Completing result uploads, calculations and accurate data entry.
- Checking data entry and calculations completed outside of the LIMS system.
- Supporting the wider customer service function as required.

These duties are not exhaustive and should not be interpreted as a complete definition of the role.

About You

We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, organised and confident communicating with a wide range of people. You will be comfortable working in a busy environment, managing competing priorities and maintaining a high level of accuracy.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience in a customer service role
- Experience working in a fast-paced environment - desirable.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- A professional and confident telephone manner.
- Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
- Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
- The ability to manage your own workload effectively.
- A collaborative, "one team" approach.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Strong numerical and accurate data-entry skills.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office 365, Excel and Word.
- The ability and willingness to learn and use various in-house systems and processes.
- A positive and adaptable approach to change.
- Flexibility and the ability to adapt to changing priorities.

Company Benefits

In addition to joining a well-established and growing organisation, the successful candidate will receive the following benefits:
- Annual Leave: 22 days' holiday per year, plus bank holidays.
- Healthcare: Healthcare provision.
- Death in Service: Life cover equivalent to four times your annual salary.
- Company Pension: Access to a company pension scheme.
- Free on-site parking

Interested?

If you are looking for a permanent Customer Service Advisor opportunity with a growing organisation and believe you have the skills and experience required, we would love to hear from you.

Please get in touch to find out more and discuss the opportunity in further detail.

Please be aware this advert will remain open until the vacancy has been filled. Interviews will take place throughout this period, therefore we encourage you to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Tate is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Tate is committed to promoting equal opportunities. To ensure that every candidate has the best experience with us, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments we can make during the application or interview process. Your comfort and accessibility are our priority, and we are here to support you every step of the way. Additionally, we value and respect your individuality, and we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application.

title: Document Controller
description:
Document Controller - Watford

Location: Watford, Hertfordshire
Position: Document Controller
Sector: Main Contractor / Construction
Salary: Competitive + Package

The Opportunity

We are currently recruiting for an experienced Document Controller to join a leading main contractor on a construction project based in Watford.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established contractor with a strong pipeline of projects across the UK.

The successful candidate will have previous experience working on-site within the construction industry, ideally for a main contractor, and will be confident managing project documentation while supporting the wider site team.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and maintain project documentation, ensuring accurate filing, tracking and distribution.
- Control drawings, technical submissions, RFIs and other construction documentation.
- Ensure all project information is kept up to date and compliant with company procedures.
- Liaise with site teams, subcontractors, consultants and project management.
- Manage document revisions and ensure the latest information is available to relevant stakeholders.
- Support the site team with general administration and reporting.
- Maintain document registers and assist with project handover documentation.

Requirements
- Previous experience as a Document Controller within the construction industry.
- Essential: Experience working on a live construction site.
- Ideally previous experience working for a main contractor.
- Good knowledge of document management systems such as Aconex, Viewpoint, Asite or similar.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Confident communicating with site teams, subcontractors and senior management.
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

What's on Offer?
- Opportunity to work with a leading, established main contractor.
- Long-term career development and progression opportunities.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Supportive and professional project team.

Apply Now

If you are an experienced Document Controller with construction site experience and are interested in an opportunity in Watford, please apply or get in touch for a confidential discussion.
